summary: The change, now rebased onto the new base, still moves `west` to `staging.gethalo.dev` with `redirectWww: "false"` and updates `infra/README.md` so that `prod` is production and `west` is staging. The source and README remain correct. The temp test run failed, because `apps/electron/.tmp-tests/ControlPlaneAuth.test.ts` cannot be imported, so the change cannot be approved until every temp test run passes.

findings.body:
The temp suite fails to load. The test fails before any test runs, at line 17 (`await import("../src/main/auth/ControlPlaneAuth.js")`). The error is `Cannot find module .../@tanishqkancharla/tandem-core/dist/TandemClient` (see `.tmp-tests/report/tmp.log`). The cause is in the dependency, not in this change: `tandem-core/dist/index.js` line 1 has the extensionless ESM import `export { TandemClient } from "./TandemClient"`, and Node cannot resolve it.

This change touches only `infra/README.md` and `Pulumi.west.yaml`, so this Electron temp test does not exercise anything in the diff. Fix it in one of these ways so that the temp run passes:

- Remove it from this change's temp tests.
- Mock the module chain that pulls in `tandem-core`.
- Repair the dependency install or build after the rebase.
